description: Deal 1 damage. The damaged unit may catch fire (Ablaze). In a stacked fire, each flame beyond the first may burn again.
Venom X — apply X stacks of Poison. Each stack costs its victim 1 health when it activates, so a recurring Venom X sustains about X damage a round: what it is worth to whoever deals it.
Blind X — apply X stacks of the Blind status. Each stack is a charge: one attack, 50% chance to miss. Worth X to the unit that deals it.
